correctness.rationale: For T_n(F_q)=I([n],F_q), an idempotent with prescribed binary diagonal has exactly one free field entry for every upper-triangular opposite-bit pair, by induction on separation using [P,P²-P]=0. A generating tuple has pairwise-distinct binary diagonal vectors and on each adjacent two-by-two quotient an offdiagonal generator vector not proportional to the difference of diagonals. This yields q^{h_{ij}} options on all noncover pairs, and q^{h_{i,i+1}}-q on each cover; summing over injective vertex labels gives the claimed weighted finite sum, independent of characteristic. Independent finite weighted calculations give G_{2,2}(2)=8,G_{3,3}(2)=1920,G_{3,3}(3)=36288. The unrestricted proof is algebraic; finite enumeration is corroborative.
